decision: Do not certify this reconstruction and do not use it to resume or pool with historical EXP-002J4. The primary breadth effect is directionally incompatible with the supported historical benchmark. No parameters were tuned to historical outputs.
scientific_interpretation: The durable invariants are insufficient to uniquely recover historical EXP-002 behavior. A new explicitly versioned benchmark may still be constructed, but it must establish its own baseline before transfer experiments.
